planet.firstcrusade.imperial_capital.des: A massive Imperial capital covered by enormous cities, military districts, cathedrals, manufactorums and command centres. It serves as one of the main strategic hubs for Imperial forces. Recruit soldiers, trade resources, receive military missions and access advanced technology. The central regions are secure; the outer wastes are not.
planet.firstcrusade.imperial_capital.res: Military supplies, recruitment, advanced technology, trade.
planet.firstcrusade.cadia.description: A heavily fortified world positioned near an unstable region of space. Its cities, fortresses and defensive lines have been built for permanent warfare. Travelling to Cadia gives access to large military conflicts, defensive missions, Imperial recruitment and valuable salvage.
planet.firstcrusade.cadia.resources: Military supplies, weapons, armour and strategic materials.
planet.firstcrusade.armageddon.descripti: An industrial world consumed by constant warfare. Vast hive-factories pour smoke into a sky that has not been clear in centuries, and the greenskin war never truly ends. Vehicle production, industrial salvage and urban battles on a scale nothing else matches.
planet.firstcrusade.forge_world.descript: A world owned by the Adeptus Mechanicus, where the horizon is manufactorum and the air tastes of oil. Weapon production, advanced technology and industrial defence missions. Nothing grows here that was not built.
planet.firstcrusade.hive_world.descripti: Towering hive cities holding billions, stacked over an underhive nobody governs. Gangs, corruption, factories and internal conflict. Urban missions and a population large enough that nobody counts the losses.
planet.firstcrusade.agri_world.descripti: Endless cultivated continents feeding a dozen war zones. Farms, fields, forests and small towns, defended by militia rather than by armies. Raids on the harvest are the war here.
planet.firstcrusade.ork_world.descriptio: Hostile territory from orbit down. Ork camps, scrap fortresses, hordes and the Warbosses that drive them. Conquest events, high risk and rewards to match. Nothing on this world wants a negotiation.
planet.firstcrusade.necron_tomb_world.de: Ancient ruins over structures that go down further than any survey has mapped. The technology here is not understood, and the things sleeping under it are counting. Rare resources, dangerous expeditions and awakening events.
planet.firstcrusade.necron_tomb_world.re: Living metal, unknown technology, rare artefacts.
planet.firstcrusade.catachan.description: A death world of jungle and swamp where the flora is as hostile as anything with teeth. The Imperium holds only what it can defend daily. Everything here is either poisonous, armoured, or both.
planet.firstcrusade.valhalla.description: An ice world whose temperature never rises above freezing. Imperial garrisons hold the habitable belts; everything else is tundra over the bones of older wars.

node.firstcrusade.astra_recruit.desc: The oath is taken. The tree opens.
Drill until the body stops complaining. +1 max health per rank.
node.firstcrusade.flak_armour_training.d: Wear the plate as if it were skin. +0.4 armour per rank.
node.firstcrusade.lasgun_training.desc: The Guard's rifle, fired properly. +3% personal ranged damage per rank.
node.firstcrusade.secondary_heart.desc: The first organ. A second heart to carry what one cannot.
node.firstcrusade.forced_march.desc: Ground is taken with the feet. +2% movement speed per rank.
Stand still and ask. Two seconds of channelling, then absorption hearts.
node.firstcrusade.pain_tolerance.desc: A wound is information, not an argument. -1.5% damage taken per rank.
node.firstcrusade.ossmodula.desc: The skeleton thickens and fuses. Bone becomes armour.
node.firstcrusade.close_combat.desc: Knife, chainblade, fist. +0.4 melee damage per rank.
node.firstcrusade.field_recovery.desc: Field medicine, applied under fire. +8% med-kit healing per rank.
node.firstcrusade.assault_step.desc: Land and keep moving. -8% fall damage per rank; higher step at rank 5.
node.firstcrusade.biscopea.desc: Muscle grows where the organ tells it to. The frame fills out.
node.firstcrusade.haemic_reserve.desc: Blood to spare. +1 max health per rank.
node.firstcrusade.psalm_of_protection.de: The prayer holds longer and returns sooner. +3s duration, -8s cooldown per rank.
node.firstcrusade.xenos_hunter.desc: Know where a greenskin keeps its organs. +3% damage to Orks per rank.
node.firstcrusade.haemastamen.desc: The blood itself is rewritten. From here you are no longer an ordinary man.
node.firstcrusade.out_of_combat_recovery: Once the shooting stops, the body starts. Slow healing out of combat.
node.firstcrusade.tactical_roll.desc: A short dash the way you are facing. Never through a wall.
node.firstcrusade.iron_liturgy.desc: The answered prayer leaves Resistance behind. +3s per rank.
node.firstcrusade.larraman_organ.desc: Wounds close themselves. Below a quarter health, one emergency clot.
node.firstcrusade.fire_discipline.desc: Faster between shots. -2% weapon cooldown per rank.
node.firstcrusade.unshakeable_stance.des: Hit, and stay where you were. +0.03 knockback resistance per rank.
node.firstcrusade.emperors_vigil.desc: Poison, blindness, weakness: all of it passes faster. -5% duration per rank.
node.firstcrusade.catalepsean_node.desc: Half the brain sleeps while the other half watches. The night stops mattering.
node.firstcrusade.enhanced_metabolism.de: More out of every ration. +6% food efficiency per rank.
node.firstcrusade.battle_memory.desc: A streak teaches. Bonus progression XP while the killing continues.
node.firstcrusade.xenos_executioner.desc: For the big ones. +4% damage to Ork elites per rank.
node.firstcrusade.preomnor_omophagea.des: A pre-stomach that judges what you swallow, and flesh that remembers.
node.firstcrusade.assault_breath.desc: Run further on the same meal. -8% sprint hunger per rank.
node.firstcrusade.trained_lungs.desc: Hold it. Longer underwater, and poison bites less.
node.firstcrusade.moving_fire.desc: Shoot while walking without throwing the shot away.
node.firstcrusade.multi_lung.desc: A third lung that filters what the other two cannot.
node.firstcrusade.marksmans_eye.desc: Tighter groups, faster bolts. +2% accuracy per rank.
node.firstcrusade.combat_balance.desc: Aim and reload cost less speed. Steadier after a roll.
node.firstcrusade.psalm_of_vigilance.des: The answered prayer shows you the enemy. Never an ally.
node.firstcrusade.occulobe_lyman.desc: Eyes that grow in the dark, and an ear that refuses to be deafened.
node.firstcrusade.sus_an_sleep.desc: Near death, stop. Heavy resistance, slow healing, no attacking.
node.firstcrusade.war_skin.desc: Fire, lava, the world itself. -5% environmental damage per rank.
node.firstcrusade.armoured_advance.desc: Heavy plate stops being heavy. Better movement and step in armour.
node.firstcrusade.susan_melanochrome_ool: Sus-an Membrane, Melanochrome and Oolitic Kidney
Three organs against three deaths: stasis, radiation and poison.
node.firstcrusade.neuroglottis.desc: Taste what is wrong before you swallow it.
node.firstcrusade.betcher_gland.desc: Spit acid. Short range, no blocks harmed, no ally touched.
node.firstcrusade.mucranoid.desc: The answered prayer leaves a wax against the flames. +3s per rank.
node.firstcrusade.chemical_maturity.desc: The chemical organs settle. Genetically, you are finished.
node.firstcrusade.neural_interface.desc: The nerves learn the armour's language. Required before full plate.
node.firstcrusade.death_angel_march.desc: In Power Armour: faster, higher step, harder to move.
node.firstcrusade.death_angel_litany.des: The prayer covers the brothers beside you, in a smaller measure.

command_node.firstcrusade.imperial_autho: The Administratum recognises you as a commander in the field. Grants no troops by itself, but nothing else in this tree opens without it.
command_node.firstcrusade.squad_vox.desc: A vox-link to the nearest Imperial base. Up to 3 Guardsmen answer a raid you declare.
command_node.firstcrusade.reinforced_squ: The garrison releases a fuller squad: up to 5 Guardsmen.
command_node.firstcrusade.combat_section: A proven commander may call a combat section: up to 7 Guardsmen. Requires two raids won.
command_node.firstcrusade.assault_platoo: The full weight of a base's garrison: up to 10 Guardsmen. No commander calls more. Requires four raids won.
command_node.firstcrusade.field_sergeant: A squad of five or more goes out under a Sergeant, when the base has one. None is created for you.
command_node.firstcrusade.priority_vox.d: Your requests jump the queue: a quarter off the wait between raids. It does not let you call twice in one raid.
command_node.firstcrusade.forward_insert: The squad is set down some 70 blocks out instead of 100 - still on safe ground, never inside the camp.
command_node.firstcrusade.coordinated_as: On reaching the camp the squad gains Speed I and a steadier footing for 20 seconds. It does not stack.
